parts:
Dear INLA community,

I have fitted a spatiotemporal type 4 interaction model along with covariates. I would like to calculate the contribution of variance due to fixed effects and random effects. I have used the following code for calculating variance of different random components. Kindly advise me if my calculations are correct.

rm(list = ls())
library(spdep); library(INLA); library(tmap);library('sf');library("rgdal");library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#Calculate variance proportions
load("d:\\VL model_2\\vicente_52_models\\Modified_data_covariate_avg\\Output_E_base\\models with covariates\\bym2_rw1_t4_cov_training 2013-2018_20 may 2022.RData")

marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4= inla.hyperpar.sample(100000,model_bym2.rw1.t4)

var_prop = tibble(`Random Effects Term` = c("Unstructured Spatial",
                                            "Structured Spatial",
                                            "Unstructured Temporal",
                                            "Structured Temporal",
                                            "Space-Time Interaction"),
                 
                  `bym2.rw1.t4 With Interaction` = c(mean(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,1]/(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,1]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,2]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,3]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,4]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,5])),
                                                     mean(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,2]/(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,1]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,2]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,3]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,4]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,5])),
                                                     mean(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,3]/(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,1]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,2]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,3]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,4]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,5])),
                                                     mean(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,4]/(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,1]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,2]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,3]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,4]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,5])),
                                                     mean(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,5]/(1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,1]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,2]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,3]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,4]+1/marg_hyper_bym2.rw1.t4[,5]))))

var_prop = var_prop %>%
  mutate(`bym2_rw1.t4 ` = round(`bym2.rw1.t4 With Interaction`*100,3),
         `bym2.rw1.t4` = round(`bym2.rw1.t4 With Interaction`*100,3))
 
Also I would appreciate your advise on how to calculate the overall variance of (i) fixed effects and (ii) random effects.

Thanks in advance
ssubra
